name: Azure Bee
desc: A calm bee infused with cool energy, boosting blue pollen collection and refreshing nearby flowers. Its soothing aura increases efficiency and supports allies, making it essential for steady resource gathering and growth.

tokens.desc:
Grants +15% Blue Pollen for 60s.
Stacks up to 10 times.

Gathers 4 Pollen from 21 flowers with a power of 7.
Additionally, it gathers x2 Pollen from Blue Flowers and grants up to 35 stacks of Bomb Combo Boost.

name: Basic Bee
desc: A simple and reliable bee with balanced abilities. It gathers pollen steadily, converts resources efficiently, and supports your hive with consistent performance. Perfect for beginners building a strong and dependable foundation.

name: Bomber Bee
desc: A destructive bee that drops explosive bombs, instantly collecting pollen from surrounding flowers. Its powerful blasts clear large areas quickly, making it perfect for fast farming and overwhelming field coverage.

tokens.desc:
Gathers 6 Pollen from 21 flowers with a power of 7.
Additionally, grants up to 35 stacks of Bomb Combo Boost.

Gathers 6 Pollen from 37 flowers with a power of 7.
Additionally, grants up to 35 stacks of Bomb Combo Boost

name: Celestial Bee
desc: Came down on a rainbow for the first event. When it calls, the sky opens and stars fall on your field.

tokens.desc:
Calls down 12 falling stars (+1 per bee level). Each star gathers 50 Pollen * Heavenfall Pollen from a 3x3 patch.
Catch a star to gain Heavenfall Boost (+25% Heavenfall Pollen, stacks x10, 15s) and instantly convert pollen like your whole hive, multiplied by Heavenfall Pollen.
Stars landing on Heaven tiles gather a 5x5 patch and stay catchable longer.

Turns flowers around you into Heaven tiles for 15s.
Heaven tiles are upgraded and gather 8 Pollen * Heavenfall Pollen every 1.5s, with 25% instantly converted to honey.
Heavenfall stars landing on Heaven tiles gather a 5x5 patch and stay catchable longer.

Spends all your Heavenfall Boost stacks.
For 10s: Ascended Boost (+10% Movespeed and +3% Bee Ability Rate per stack spent) and your whole hive converts pollen to honey every 2s, wherever you are.
Then a beam of light strikes the field, gathering Pollen in an area that grows with the stacks spent (most of the field at x10).

name: Cloud Bee
desc: A celestial bee adrift in an endless sky, its body woven from billowing cumulus clouds. It summons gusts of swirling wind to scatter pollen far across the field, enveloping nearby flowers in a soft, misty vapor that suspends decay and magnifies pollen yield while its airy aura drifts through the area in a sweeping, ever-shifting current of boundless atmospheric energy.

tokens.desc:
Creates 2 Clouds (+1 every 5 Levels) for 10s (+1 every Level) that regenerate flowers and gather Pollen.
Additionally, they gather x1.5 Pollen from White Flowers.

Grants +4% Cloud Pollen, +2% White Pollen, and 4% Capacity Bonus for 60s.
Stacks up to 35 times.

name: Coal Bee
desc: A smoldering bee forged from deep earth pressure. It scorches nearby flowers, hardening their cores and boosting red pollen collection while radiating raw heat that fuels efficiency and ensures relentless, unyielding resource extraction.

tokens.desc:
Grants +15% Red Pollen for 60s.
Stacks up to 10 times.

Grants +2% Fire Pollen for 90s.
Stacks up to 100 times.

name: Cold Bee
desc: A chilling bee infused with icy power. It freezes nearby flowers, slowing decay and boosting blue pollen collection while providing cooling effects that improve efficiency and help maintain stable resource gathering performance.

tokens.desc:
Grants +15% Blue Pollen for 60s.
Stacks up to 10 times.

Gathers 8 Pollen from 9 flowers with a power of 3.
Additionally, it gathers x2 Pollen from Blue Flowers and covers flowers in Ice for 12s.

name: Crimson Bee
desc: A fierce bee filled with blazing power, specializing in red pollen collection and aggressive boosts. It enhances attack strength and burns through fields quickly, helping your hive dominate and collect resources faster.

tokens.desc:
Grants +15% Red Pollen for 60s.
Stacks up to 10 times.

Gathers 4 Pollen from 21 flowers with a power of 7.
Additionally, it gathers x2 Pollen from Red Flowers and grants up to 35 stacks of Bomb Combo Boost.

name: Exp Bee
desc: A luminous bee glowing with concentrated knowledge and energy. It flits purposefully through the field, leaving trails of sparkling wisdom and radiant experience orbs in its wake while its brilliant aura resonates with an empowering frequency that accelerates growth and amplifies the learning gained from every blossom it touches.

tokens.desc: Gathers 4 Pollen (+3 every Level) from 21 flowers with a power of 7.
Grants 1 Exp Orb (+1 every 1 Level) that gives 100 XP when fed to a bee.

Grants x1.15 Capacity Bonus and x1.05 Obsidian Pollen for 90s.
Stacks up to 5 times.

name: Fire Bee
desc: A fiery bee radiating intense heat and energy. It scorches flowers to boost red pollen collection, increases attack power, and spreads burning effects that rapidly enhance harvesting speed and field productivity.

tokens.desc:
Grants +15% Red Pollen for 60s.
Stacks up to 10 times.

Gathers 8 Pollen from 9 flowers with a power of 3.
Additionally, it gathers x2 Pollen from Red Flowers and covers flowers in Fire for 6s.

name: Firework Bee
desc: A radiant bee crackling with festive power. It detonates cascading bursts across the field, showering flowers in luminous sparks and amplifying pollen yield while its brilliant explosions ripple outward, fueling a dazzling and relentless surge of collection.

tokens.desc: Creates 2 Fireworks (+1 every 5 Levels), each one gathering from 5 flowers and covering them in Fire for 6s.

Gathers 8 Pollen from 9 flowers with a power of 3.
Additionally, it gathers x2 Pollen from Red Flowers and covers flowers in Fire for 6s.

name: Flower Bee
desc: A gentle bee devoted to nurturing flowers. It enhances bloom speed, increases pollen yield from blossoms, and spreads growth energy across fields, making nearby plants more rewarding and efficient to harvest.

tokens.desc:
Grants +15% White Pollen for 60s.
Stacks up to 10 times.

name: Hasty Bee
desc: An energetic bee that increases movement speed and attack rate for the hive. Its rapid actions help collect pollen faster, dodge threats, and improve overall efficiency during intense gathering sessions.

tokens.desc:
Grants +5% Movespeed for 60s.
Stacks up to 10.

name: Honey Bee
desc: A pure bee dedicated to the sweet essence of honey production, converting pollen with unmatched efficiency and quality. Its natural affinity for nectar creates premium honey reserves, serving as the foundation for any successful hive.

tokens.desc: Converts 100 * (Total Conversion) * (Bee's Level) Pollen into 5 Honey Tokens.

name: Ice Bee
desc: A crystalline architect carved from eternal permafrost, shimmering with a frigid, silent grace. It glides through the air on wings of sheer frost, trailing a mist of absolute zero and delicate snowflakes that freeze moments of insight into permanent memory; its chilling aura stills the chaos of the mind, allowing for a focused, rhythmic harvest of clarity from the petals of the frozen field.

tokens.desc:
Grants +15% Blue Pollen for 60s.
Stacks up to 10 times.

Creates an Ice Crystal for 8s (+1 every 3 Levels) that collects Blue Tokens.
Additionally, it spreads Ice for each token it collects.

name: Icicle Bee
desc: A frigid bee encased in piercing ice. It launches razor-sharp icicles across the field, freezing nearby flowers in a crystalline frost that slows decay and amplifies pollen yield while its glacial aura blankets the area in a relentless, bone-chilling surge of frozen energy.

tokens.desc: Creates 2 Icicles (+1 every 5 Levels), each one gathering from 5 flowers and covering them in Ice for 15s.

Gathers 8 Pollen from 9 flowers with a power of 3.
Additionally, it gathers x2 Pollen from Blue Flowers and covers flowers in Ice for 12s.

name: Kishin Bee
desc: The embodiment of wrath, rage, and soul-eating despair set on evisceration and purification of souls unfortunate enough to wander in its path.

tokens.desc: Converts nearest Fire into Soulfire, extending its life and granting Psyfire Boost.
A devilish contract, forcing the user to sacrifice a portion of the soul to achieve immense power, with consequence.
Creates a torrent of flames, lasting for 6 seconds base, granting Chaining Boost for 12s.

name: Kitsune Bee
desc: A mythical bee infused with the cunning spirit of the kitsune. It weaves through flowers with uncanny agility, tricking pollen into yielding more than it should, and rewards sharp, strategic hive management.

tokens.desc:
Grants x1.02 White Pollen, x1.07 Blossom Pollen, and x1.04 Blossom Time for 45s.
Stacks up to 25 times.
Triggers all bombs on the field. The bombs get boosted by Blossom Pollen and upgrade flowers in their radius for 10s * Blossom Time.
Creates a rain of 12 Blossom Leafs (+3 every 5 Levels), each one gathering 150 Pollen * Blossom Pollen and upgrade flowers for 2s * Blossom Time & covers flowers in obsidian for 11s.

name: Lion Bee
desc: A majestic bee that rules the field with commanding presence, its mighty roar boosting all nearby bees' abilities. Its proud strength and territorial dominance ensure superior pollen collection while protecting its kingdom from threats.

tokens.desc:
Grants +10% Attack Bonus for 60s.
Stacks up to 4 times.
Attacks all mobs on the field for 5 damage * (Bee's Level).

name: Lucky Bee
desc: A shimmering bee radiating with golden fortune. It dances unpredictably across the field, scattering bursts of lucky clover and glittering tokens wherever it roams while its warm, glowing aura pulses with a magnetic charm that draws in rare treasures and multiplies the rewards of every flower it graces.

tokens.desc:
Grants +25% Pollen and +25% Loot Luck for 30s.
Stacks up to 2 times.

Grants +100% Pollen, +100% Loot Luck, and +100% Capacity Bonus for 30s.
(Very Rare).
Summons a Pot O' Gold that fills with the Pollen gathered near it by your Tool for 14s (+1 every 5 Levels). Once the time is up, the Pollen inside is converted into x2 Honey Tokens!

name: Lunar Bee
desc: A moonlit wanderer cloaked in silvered frost and shimmering starlight. As it drifts through the hive, it leaves a trailing wake of pale luminescence and frozen dew; its very presence radiates a calm, otherworldly glow that soothes raw instinct into serene focus, distilling the essence of every flower it visits into a shimmering, tranquil nectar of clarity.

tokens.desc:
White stars fall from the sky for 10s, each one gathering pollen in a 3x3.
Stars that land on a Bubble turn it into a Lunar Bubble (x1.5 capacity).
Stars that hit an active Magnet turn it into a Lunar Magnet (10% chance to duplicate every token it grabs).

Grants Lunar Sync for 30s: +20% Night Capacity, +15% Night Pollen, and night buffs work at 50% during the day.
With Solar Sync active, night buffs work at 100% during the day.

name: Magma Bee
desc: A core-heated sentinel forged from molten stone and pulsing obsidian. As it drones through the hive, it leaves a scorching trail of liquid fire and crystalline embers; its very presence radiates an intense, transformative heat that tempers raw potential into hardened skill, refining the essence of every flower it visits into a potent, concentrated nectar of power.

tokens.desc:
Grants +15% Red Pollen for 60s.
Stacks up to 10 times.

Creates a Fire Crystal for 8s (+1 every 3 Levels) that collects Red Tokens.
Additionally, it spreads Fire for each token it collects.

name: Magnet Bee
desc: A magnetic bee that attracts nearby tokens and resources directly to the magnet. Its powerful pull draws in collectibles from a wide radius, reducing travel time and maximizing haul efficiency during every gathering run.

tokens.desc: Creates a Magnet that collects tokens in a 20x20 radius

name: Null Bee
desc: A mysterious bee that exists in a void state, eager to destroy any pollen it comes across.

tokens.desc: Creates 6 Prism Beams (+2 Every 3 Levels), each one gathering 250 Pollen.
Voids X pollen from your bag.

name: Oil Bee
desc: A viscous bee gleaming with dark iridescence, its form composed of flowing obsidian streams that ripple with rainbow sheens. It releases thick, amber droplets that coat the field in protective resin, encasing nearby flowers in a preserving glaze that extends their lifespan and intensifies their essence while its slick aura spreads through the area in slow, deliberate waves of liquid preservation and ancient, earthbound energy.

tokens.desc:
Grants +0.1% Fire Pollen permanently.
Can stack up to 5000 times.

Gathers 8 Pollen from 9 flowers with a power of 3.
Additionally, it gathers x2 Pollen from Red Flowers and covers flowers in Fire for 6s.

name: Oni Bee
desc: A fearsome bee possessed by an oni's restless spirit. It tears through fields with relentless aggression, smashing through pollen caps that would slow ordinary bees, built for players who want raw, unforgiving power.

tokens.desc:
Grants 5% Critical Power, 0.5% Critical Chance, and x1.03 Fire Pollen for 45s.
Stacks up to 25 times.
At max stack creates 8 fire tiles randomly on field.

Spread Soul Fire to 9 flowers that lasts for 21s (+1 every Level).
Additionally, Soul Fire gathers x3 more than Fire and grants Soul Fire Combo.
Makes Fire and Soul Fire convert ( (Total Hive Attack * 10) * (Bee Level * 5) * (Fire Pollen / 27) ) Pollen into (1 * (Convert Amount/50) ) Honey every 1s / Soul Duration for 7s.

name: Pixel Bee
desc: A retro-inspired bee built from blocks of pure nostalgia. Its pixelated form may look simple, but don't be fooled — beneath those sharp edges lies a surprisingly capable worker. A charming collectible for those who appreciate the classics.

tokens.desc: Grants x1.2 Pollen and x1.2 Capacity Bonus for 60s.

name: Pumpkin Bee
desc: A festive bee grown under the Hollow Moon. It plants magical pumpkins that pop into Pumpkin Blessing tiles.

tokens.desc: Spawns 3 pumpkins for 20s. Gathering pollen near a pumpkin makes it grow. They pop instantly when full. When they pop, they spread Pumpkin Blessing tiles - bigger pumpkins spread more and stronger tiles.

Spawns a giant pumpkin that grows for 20s as you gather pollen near it.
It pops instantly when full. The fuller it is, the more of the field it covers in Pumpkin Blessing - a full Dreadnought covers most of the field.

name: Rage Bee
desc: An furious bee consumed by uncontrollable anger, attacking flowers with violent intensity to extract maximum pollen. Its explosive temper multiplies collection power but burns through stamina, perfect for short bursts of overwhelming production.

tokens.desc:
Grants +1 Bee Attack for 60s.
Stacks up to 3 times.

Gathers 6 Pollen from 21 flowers with a power of 7.
Additionally, grants up to 35 stacks of Bomb Combo Boost.

name: Ryujin Bee
desc: A legendary bee channeling the might of the ryujin. It commands the hive with draconic authority, surging pollen production in powerful bursts and overwhelming rivals with sheer dominance.

tokens.desc: Creates 1 + (1 Per 5 Levels) Bubbles that has ( (1/10 of player's capacity * (1 + Bee's Level / 10) ) * Bubble Capacity) and lasts for 10s * Bubble Time. When expiring, they pop, giving Bubble Combo Honey.

Grants x1.015 Blue Pollen, x1.02 Ice Pollen, x1.045 Bubble Pollen, and 1.5% Bubble Time for 90s.
Stacks up to 100 times.
Increases all active bubbles' Capacity by 4% and Pollen by 10%.

name: Science Bee
desc: An analytical bee equipped with experimental apparatus that converts collected resources into research data. Its methodical approach increases token quality through systematic observation, occasionally discovering rare specimens and bonus materials that other bees would overlook during standard gathering operations.

tokens.desc:
Grants 10% Energy Bonus for 60s.
Stacks up to 10 times.

name: Shark Bee
desc: A ferocious bee that hunts through fields with predatory precision, aggressively collecting pollen in devastating sweeps. Its razor-sharp instincts and relentless speed tear through flowers, dominating any territory it claims.

tokens.desc: Attacks all mobs on the field for 25 damage * (Bee's Level).

Creates 2 Waves (+1 every 5 Levels) around the token, each one gathering 12 Pollen from 21 flowers every 0.3s for 5s.
Additionally, they collect all tokens in their path.

name: Sound Bee
desc: A resonant bee vibrating with sonic frequency. It reverberates through nearby flowers, amplifying their bloom and boosting echo pollen collection while emitting harmonic waves that sharpen efficiency and sustain a rhythmic, uninterrupted resource flow.

tokens.desc:
Grants +5% Capacity for 30s.
Stacks up to 10 times.

Gathers 6 Pollen from 37 flowers with a power of 7.
Additionally, grants up to 35 stacks of Bomb Combo Boost

Grants +2% Critical Chance and 5% Critical Power for 45s.
Stacks up to 5 times.

name: Splatter Bee
desc: An artistic bee that splashes paint across the field. Summons spinning paintbrushes that enhance nearby flowers with paint and spins a colorful wheel for stat boosts.

tokens.desc:
Spins a color wheel that grants one of three boosts for 10s (+1s every 2 Levels). The winning color cannot appear on the next spin.
White: x1.15 Bomb Pollen, x1.10 Pollen, +10% Bee Ability Rate
Red: +25% Attack, +25% Bee Movespeed, +25% Bee Gather Speed
Blue: +50% Tool Pollen, +25% Tool Speed, x1.25 Capacity
Summons a spinning brush that drops paint on nearby Tokens. Each splash upgrades flowers for 10s (+1s every 2 Levels) and applies a random Paint effect.

passive.name: Magic Brush
passive.desc: Paint effects created by Splatter Bee retain the properties of their original effects while allowing bees to interact with them and create Tiny Paint Bees.

name: Sunny Bee
desc: A radiant bee that radiates intense sunlight, warming flowers to boost pollen production. Its brilliant golden glow energizes nearby bees and accelerates honey conversion, making it essential for maximizing field efficiency.

tokens.desc:
Creates 2 Sun Beams (+1 every 5 Levels). A yellow 3x3 warning appears, then a laser burns the flowers there and sets them on fire.
Standing inside a beam when it lands gives Burned (100 stacks that burn down to 0 in 8s): up to +25% Movespeed, +10% Bee Movespeed, +50% Daytime Pollen, +50% Fire Pollen.

Grants Solar Sync for 30s: +20% Daytime Capacity, +15% Daytime Pollen, and day buffs work at 50% at night.
With Lunar Sync active, day buffs work at 100% at night.

name: Tanuki Bee
desc: A mythical bee blessed by the playful spirit of the tanuki. Rather than creating power on its own, it turns well-prepared fields into incredible fortune, rewarding clever timing and synergizing perfectly with Kitsune Bee's Blossoms.

tokens.desc:
Creates an explosion that gathers pollen from 4x7 tiles and grants x1.08 White Pollen, x1.008 Obsidian Pollen, x1.02 Blossom Pollen and +3.2% Bomb Pollen for 45s (x3, x1.2, x1.5 and +80% at 25 stacks).
Stacks up to 25 times. Counts towards Blossom Combo.

For 20s, harvesting Spirit Blossoms or collecting White tokens grants Honey, Instant Conversion or Pollen.
Spirit Blossoms can drop Lucky Tokens and Fortune Charms.

Creates a Fortune Zone for 25s that spawns Fortune Charms.
Fortune Charms have a chance to appear near Spirit Blossoms and Kitsune tokens.

name: Thunder Bee
desc: A tempestuous bee crackling with electric fury, its form wreathed in storm clouds that pulse with veins of lightning. It calls forth thunderous roars that shake the earth and ignite the air with cascading bolts, charging nearby flowers with raw electrical energy that accelerates their growth while its crackling aura surges through the area in violent, electrifying waves of pure storm-born power.

tokens.desc:
Grants +0.1% Cloud Pollen permanently.
Can stack up to 5000 times.

Gathers 6 Pollen from 37 flowers with a power of 7.
Additionally, grants up to 35 stacks of Bomb Combo Boost

name: Water Bee
desc: A fluid bee coursing with tidal energy. It hydrates nearby flowers, accelerating growth and boosting aqua pollen collection while generating gentle currents that enhance efficiency and help sustain a steady, flowing resource output.

tokens.desc:
Grants +15% Blue Pollen for 60s.
Stacks up to 10 times.

Grants +2% Ice Pollen for 90s.
Stacks up to 100 times.

name: Wave Bee
desc: An oceanic bee flowing like liquid starlight, its body formed from cascading tidal currents that shimmer with deep blue luminescence. It conjures rhythmic pulses of crystalline water that wash over the field in gentle, nourishing waves, bathing nearby flowers in healing moisture that enhances their vitality while its fluid aura ebbs and flows through the area in endless, hypnotic cycles of aquatic serenity.

tokens.desc:
Grants +0.1% Ice Pollen permanently.
Can stack up to 5000 times.

Gathers 8 Pollen from 9 flowers with a power of 3.
Additionally, it gathers x2 Pollen from Blue Flowers and covers flowers in Ice for 12s.

name: Windy Bee
desc: A translucent spirit of the atmosphere, composed of swirling zephyrs and captured starlight. It moves with a restless, unpredictable elegance, leaving behind spiraling slipstreams of inspiration and echoing whispers of ancient secrets; its breezy resonance lifts the spirit, accelerating the pace of discovery and carrying the pollen of innovation across vast distances with a single, effortless gust.

tokens.desc:
Grants +15% White Pollen for 60s.
Stacks up to 10 times.

Creates a Windy Crystal for 8s (+1 every 3 Levels) that collects White Tokens.
Additionally, it creates 2 Clouds for each token it collects.

name: Yuki-Onna Bee
desc: A mythical bee born from a winter spirit. It freezes your bag in place, calls down blizzards and rolls giant snowballs across the field.

tokens.desc: Freezes your pollen counter for 1.2s so your bag can't fill. Each Soulfrost adds another 1.2s (15s max).

A field-wide snowstorm for 15s that spawns Snowflake Tokens. The storm freezes flowers into ice patches.
Each Snowflake: +0.1% Bubble Pollen, +0.2% Bubble Capacity, +1.5% Ice Pollen, +1% Blue Pollen (stacks to 100, resets when the Blizzard ends).
Cooldown: 45s.

Rolls a Snowball for 30s that absorbs ice from flowers to grow and collects tokens.
1-15%: 1x1, 100 pollen. 15-75%: 3x3, 300 pollen. 75-100%: 4x4, 500 pollen (x Ice Pollen x Blue Pollen). Push it by walking into it until 75%.
Gives Snowball Size while it rolls and Snowball Combo when it ends.
Each Snowball Combo stack: +0.3% snowball size, +0.1% capacity, +0.05% rolling speed, +0.15% Blue Pollen, +0.045% Instant Conversion, +0.015% Bubble Capacity, +0.01% Bee Ability Rate (stacks to 1000).
Cooldown: 60s.
